calculation_steps: T0=(1/2)(7/16)(1/6)=7/192; log of product ratios gives summed obstruction only under common triple and unit path steps.
For orientation-even ratios L(reverse)=L(forward), while O09 I(reverse)=-I(forward); nonzero I prevents a common scalar.
Energy/period log rows (1,-1,1),(0,1,0) have rank 2; target (1,0,0) increases rank to 3, support (0,0,1) completes rank.
Amplitude rescaling x->cx,M->M/c,A0->A0/c^2 preserves physical z, energy and period.
Signed linear readout has pi native period, nonconstant quadratic pi/2; detector ratio rho must be certified.

result.exact_expression: L_hist=-log product(T_k/T0) conditional on historical common sigma and unit steps; orientation-even transport has parity mismatch with signed O09; E T_state/pi=A0a under physical map, so A0 unidentifiable without support or absolute M.

counterexamples_and_failures: Orientation-even cost cannot match signed O09 for both directions at nonzero winding.
Energy E and signed period identify A0a only; amplitude scaling leaves both unchanged.
Energy is constant; quadratic phase readout can return at half signed period.
